page_title: WOL 1-2 FUL | Wolves v Fulham 25/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Peter Bankes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' The resulting set piece from Fulham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+7' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+4' The referee is firm and issues Antonee Robinson (Fulham) a deserved yellow card.

90+2' A rebound falls to Raul Jimenez (Fulham) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.
90' A corner kick by Wolves is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham). The ball is out of play. Wolves win a corner kick.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing. Corner kick. Wolves will have an opportunity.
88' Fulham earn a corner.

88' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
87' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. Now Fulham have a corner.
83' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the right side of the goal. Jose Sa is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
83' Neat passing move from Fulham in order to create new attacking opportunities.

78' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
78' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is about to take a corner kick.
77' Substitution. Andre walks off the pitch and Thomas Doyle (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.
77' Vitor Pereira prepares a substitution. Santiago Bueno is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
77' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
76' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Calvin Bassey (Fulham) replacing Jorge Cuenca.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ryan Sessegnon departs the field of play to be replaced by Antonee Robinson (Fulham).
72' It will be a substitution. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is ready to enter the pitch as Rodrigo Muniz walks off.
69' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Alex Iwobi (Fulham) replaces Sasa Lukic.
67' Substitution. Adama Traore is replaced by Willian (Fulham).
65' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde makes way for Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves).
62' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
62' Toti (Wolves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
59' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' Toti (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
53' Wolves are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sander Berge (Fulham) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Close! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
47' 1 - 2 GOAL - 1:2! Adama Traore found Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Jose Sa off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make. Sasa Lukic (Fulham) will miss the next game.
45+1' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
45+1' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Wolves earn a free kick.
44' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' The game is interrupted now, Timothy Castagne (Fulham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
38' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

38' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Bernd Leno anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.

36' A short pass finds Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
35' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Bernd Leno to dive and make a save.
34' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Issa Diop (Fulham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Wolves win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
32' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
31' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Wolves will take a free kick near the side line.
28' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Santiago Bueno (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
27' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
26' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
24' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

23' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Peter Bankes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Fulham have a free kick.
22' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.
18' 1 - 1 Joao Gomes (Wolves) reacts quickly in the penalty area and volleys the ball into the roof of the net to give the goalkeeper no chance!
16' Joao Gomes (Wolves) does well to meet a cross from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde, but he directs his shot just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
14' Andre (Wolves) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
14' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Matheus Cunha (Wolves), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
13' Issa Diop (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Peter Bankes signals a set piece. A free kick to Wolves.
11' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
10' Wolves control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

6' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted! The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
4' Peter Bankes blows his whistle. Sander Berge (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Wolves.
3' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Fulham players have a reason to celebrate!
3' Wait! Referee Peter Bankes has indicated he is going to review the Fulham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
1' 0 - 1 Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Fulham will have the kick-off.
